item.blurb: Tenoro Raises €1.7M Seed. Tenoro raises €1.7M seed round led by Plus Partners to launch its AI-powered operational platform in Spain and the United States.
Rig Security Raises $12M Seed. Rig Security raises $12M in seed funding led by Ten Eleven Ventures and Brightmind Partners to secure AI agents and human identities.
MAVI Raises $4M Seed. MAVI raises $4M seed round led by Harlem Capital to connect U.S. companies with AI-proficient global accounting talent.
Destro AI Raises $8M Seed. Destro AI raises $8M in seed funding led by Base10 Partners and Bonfire Ventures to scale its robot-agnostic warehouse coordination software platform.
Prodoc AI Raises Seed Round. Prodoc AI raises a seed round led by Dr A. Velumani Family Office to expand its hospital-focused AI orchestration and patient journey platform.

No-Code Welding Robot Startup RB-Ware Raises USD 680,000 Seed Funding, Surpasses 250 Units Installed Across 16 Countries - Wowtale. No-Code Welding Robot Startup RB-Ware Raises USD 680,000 Seed Funding, Surpasses 250 Units Installed Across 16 Countries  Wowtale
Atomic Raises $12.5M Series A. Atomic raises $12.5M Series A led by Klass Capital and Madrona Venture Group to scale its autonomous supply chain AI platform.
Primer Raises $100M Series C. Primer raises $100M Series C led by Sofina to expand its unified payments infrastructure and AI-driven checkout optimization platform in the United States.
